reports.title: Azenta Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year Results for Fiscal 2026, Ended September 30, 2026.

guidance.heading: First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Guidance
section: •Total organic revenue growth is expected to range approximately between 3%-4% relative to the first quarter of fiscal 2026.
•Adjusted EBITDA margin is expected to expand by approximately 100 to 150 basis points relative to the first quarter of fiscal 2026.
The Company expects total reported revenue from continuing operations to range approximately between $648 to $660 million for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027.
•Total organic revenue growth is expected to range approximately between up 3% to 5% relative to fiscal 2026.
•Organic revenue for Sample Management Solutions is expected to grow mid-single-digits.
•Organic revenue for Multiomics is expected to grow low-single-digits.

•The high end of the fiscal 2027 revenue outlook includes the potential contributions from Elegen and SynPlexity. Fiscal 2027 is expected to be primarily a year of integration, scale-up, and commercialization of these capabilities.
•Adjusted EBITDA margin expansion of 200 to 250 basis points year-over-year, inclusive of the expected dilution of 100 basis points associated with the Elegen agreements and SynPlexity acquisition.
•Free cash flow (cash flow from operations less capital expenditures) is expected to improve approximately 25%, relative to fiscal 2026.

desk.headline: Q4 revenue up 5% to $167m and adjusted EPS $0.28, both above estimates; FY27 revenue guided to $648–660m
results: Revenue rose 5% to $167m; organic growth was 2%, with the UK Biocentre purchase adding about 3 points.
Sample Management grew 9% (4% organic) on storage services and consumables, while Multiomics was flat as Sanger and NGS sequencing slipped.
Adjusted EPS rose to $0.28 from $0.21, but GAAP EPS from continuing operations fell to $0.14 from $1.12, which had a large tax benefit.
Adjusted EBITDA margin fell 1.4 points to 11.6%; quality fixes in Automated Stores still weighed on gross margin.
The company bought back 4.4m shares for $118m in fiscal 2026 and ended the year with $506m of cash and securities and no debt.

guidance.summary: First outlook for fiscal 2027: reported revenue of $648–660m, 3–5% organic growth and a 2–2.5 point rise in adjusted EBITDA margin. The top of the revenue range relies on the newly bought Elegen and SynPlexity gene-synthesis assets.

items.new: +200–250 bps y/y (incl. ~100 bps dilution from deals)

points: Interim CEO Martin Madaus said booking trends are improving across the business and that Automated Stores quality problems can be solved.
Multiomics organic growth turned positive in the second half; management is shifting focus to NGS and gene synthesis as Sanger declines.
October cost cuts should save about $11m a year once largely done around mid-fiscal 2027, on top of earlier actions.
Elegen and SynPlexity are early-stage; fiscal 2027 is framed as a year of scale-up, with about 100 bps of margin drag.
Q1 free cash flow is expected to be negative because of capex timing; buybacks were about $68m in Q4 alone.
call.source: Earnings call transcript (Earnings Whispers, 11 Nov 2026); CEO comments in the results release

watch: Whether Q1 organic growth lands in the 3–4% range and margins start to widen.
Automated Stores bookings and the end of quality remediation costs.
Early revenue from Elegen and SynPlexity, and progress on naming a permanent CEO.
